# Plg Upgrade Prompts

`plg-upgrade-prompts` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · Conversion & Web
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/plg-upgrade-prompts/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which upgrade prompt and funnel stage is losing the most paid upgrades, and are the differences between prompts real?

**Inputs:** The free plan's limits and gates, the activation moment, and per prompt the unique users who hit the limit, saw the prompt, clicked, and upgraded in one period

**Output:** A limit and prompt map, prompt copy, an event plan, and a readout with conversion per prompt (Wilson intervals), significance between prompts, and the prompt and stage to fix first

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill plg-upgrade-prompts`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/plg-upgrade-prompts/resources/upgrade-funnel.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/plg-upgrade-prompts/resources/upgrade-funnel.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Prompts reach different users at different moments, so the fix-first gain ranks where to look, not what a change will add. Test the fix with an A/B test.
- It holds no benchmarks and only compares your prompts with each other. With small counts the corrected tests will often say prompts are not distinguishable yet.
- Counts must be unique users, one period and one attribution rule. View-through upgrades are left out, and mixed units make every rate wrong.
- It cannot see what happens after the upgrade. A prompt that lifts conversion while upgraded users churn is overselling; check retention separately.

**Review before acting:** The product or growth lead confirms the four event counts are unique users for one period, tagged by prompt, and that no limit gates the activation path, before a prompt is rewritten or moved.
